name: foundry-gate
description: Stops the shell commands your organization names, such as git push or a deploy, until an officer signs that exact command in Foundry Wallet. Then it runs once.

endpoint.title: Foundry endpoint
endpoint.description: Address of your Foundry tenant, for example https://yourcompany.digitaltrustfoundry.com

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Tenant API key that can create and read trustables. Kept in the system keychain.

signing_file.title: Signing file
signing_file.description: JSON file naming the request schema and who signs. The README shows the format.

commands.title: Gated commands
commands.description: Commands that need a signature, separated by commas.
